title: Story premise EDU110: The Drill Includes the Quiet Participant
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (public safety/preparedness). Hook: Who has not received the same usable information? Takeaway/theme: Inclusive preparedness requires consultation, usable communication, and validated assistance arrangements.
description: An event organizer wants a preparedness exercise that includes every attendee, but a verbal-only announcement omits a participant’s stated access needs. Consultation and qualified review add appropriate communication and assistance planning before the fictional drill proceeds.
